# awx_instance_group_object_roles (Data Source)

Lists the role IDs of an AWX instance group, keyed by role name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awx_instance_group_object_roles" "instance_group_groups" {
  id = data.awx_instance_group.instance_group.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) InstanceGroup ID

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Map of Number) Roles for instance_group
